notes.title: The BOTS are coming!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43936764/a727e5b58dc98042aee183fc39d02d87ee8224f2.jpg[/img]

FPS: First Person Shooter will now allow for a single player experience with the addition of bots to its free-for-all mode. This marks the beginning of the next phase of development and testing, making it possible to test more quickly and have smaller groups test independently. Up until this point FPS could only be properly tested by large group play sessions with Version Number: Fritz, that will no longer be a requirement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43936764/99e5f4dd06db9115ab1d2b979346039ca782277c.png[/img]

Version Number: Fritz
Fixes:
-Smoothed the network motion effects to reduce jittering of player objects
-Fixed all players being able to see everyone’s aim line.
-Improved network communication for bullet impact and force application on soccer ball 
-Implemented new potential fix for Kill Log issues of both players trading kills when only one should be awarded. (This time for sure)
-Fixed Player joining mind match not seeing players with proper team colors.
-Fixed Aiming area for all maps 
-Fixed Ready/Start Button lobby issue
-Fixed player spawning into floor with no body and not being able to move
-Fixed hidden maps appearing on initial lobby load.

Features and Updates:
-Added an end buzzer kazoo sound
-Added an altitude limit to the soccer ball
-Adjusted the weight of dead bodies in order to allow players to move through the dead rather than get stuck.
-Added an area below all arenas that will force a respawn if players clip through the floor.
-Controller Support!!!!! Only tested with an Xbox Controller. Needs significant additional testing!
-Bot System added
--Respawn system
--Pathfinding
--Scoring System
--Bullet Impacts
--Movement Animation system added to bots
--Bot smooth transition to new master client
--Added Random patrol system
---Added Random Gun Swing animation to give character more life.
--Added Bot Vision system and target tracking
--Added Chasing of Acquired target
---Added Gun Swivel to acquired target 
-Added Lobby bot mode selection checkbox
--Only allows selection of bot mode for maps that can support bots.
-Bot Pathfinding system added to all Free for All maps
-Main menu and lobby now have blurred gameplay video as background.
-Reordered map list to make “Park” map appear first by default
-Hid multiple testing maps to ensure new players do not have an unintended camera angle.

notes.title: Even more game modes on the way!
notes.notes:
Version Number: Mack
Fixes:
-Added a fix for kill logging and kill tracking. Possible issues still persist, will need to confirm state of system after current test phase.
-Fixed duplicate naming of players. Now anyone with a duplicate name gets a number added to their name.
-Fixed players being able to pick up more than one of the same weapon
-Fixed the no game timer issue for wide screen monitors
-Fixed Character movement animation not triggering on respawn if movement keys are held before respawn
-Added a fix for the mid-game joining issue that spawns multiple dead bodies and multiple player characters for each active player.
-Fixed Aim Line casting a shadow on the floor.

Features and Updates:
-Minimum respawn time is now set to 3 seconds.
-Players now slide against obstacles rather than stick to them.
-Turned off colliders on guns held by players.
-Changed color coding of player names
    -Enemy names are always red
    -Friendly names are always blue
    -Local player name displayed in green on kill log
-Added match countdown from 5 seconds remaining
-Added limited aspect ratio for screens. UI elements may still need to be adjusted to make this look good on all monitors.
-Added ability to hide maps by developer
-Hid video test map from test users.
-Added target direction indicator for use with game objectives
-Added indicator to Center Bomb test map for indicating the dropped bombs location.
-Player respawn time is now reduced by half if the player scores a kill.
-Added system for marking objects as heavy which reduces player speed by half when carrying.
-Nuke marked as heavy object
-Added private match toggle to all matches
-Added reduced aim line with a fade to transparency
-Added Suicide Soccer Map
-Added Soccer ball goal interaction
-Added Soccer scoring system
-Added Player Soccer ball interaction
-Added Bullet Soccer ball interaction
-Added invisible enclosure for soccer ball bounce back including ceiling
-Added match reset system for post goal scoring in soccer match.

notes.title: Yet another gamemode and a ton of features and fixes!
notes.notes:
Version Number: Gus

Fixes:
-Fixed players being able to shoot and move while the Game Menu was open.
-Fixed overlapping kill log entries
-Fixed multiple players listed for the same player with the wrong color when joining a game set to team deathmatch.
-Fixed team kill logs appearing during non-team based gameplay.
-Fixed character gravity effects
-Fixed instantaneous shooting when joining a game in progress. Player now can not shoot for first 0.2 seconds in a match.
-Fixed dying in a weapon pickup zone allowing you to grab weapon at any position after respawn.
-Fixed switch team button appearing in the lobby regardless of the gamemode
-Fixed late match joining causing match settings issues for player joining late.
-Fixed Player kills/suicides occurring at the exact same moment and no decision being rendered on which happened first. (Host now tracks order of death)
-Fixed Auto scrolling UI elements when certain peripherals are connected.

Improvements and Features:
-Added new updated city park level for both team and free-for-all play.
-Set mouse to be confined to the game window during play to keep players from clicking off screen during combat.
-Changed teammate nametags to be green
-Dead bodies despawn faster
-Added a team-based spawn system that allows for a team to have designated spawn zones where only they can respawn into.
-Created center bomb mode test arena
-Created Carriable Nuclear bomb for Center Bomb Mode
-Added Nuke explosion effect(first attempt likely to change in the future)
-Created system for scoring points not related to kill count
-Added system for resetting the position of picked up items based on a certain set of criteria
-Added massive explosion sound effect for the nuke detonation
-Switched aiming to be towards the mouse instead of away from the mouse cursor
	-Added secret system to change it back to reversed mode. In lobby host must press Ctrl+Shift+D
-Added automatic weapon pickup
-Added item and weapon pickup sound effects
-Added Bullet line for any bullet fired by an enemy that impacts player. A death line!
-Added game camera repositioning on player death by enemy. Camera now positions to a point between the victim and the killer to give more clarity on where the shot came from.
-Added multiple shotgun pickups to all existing levels.
-Added Footstep sound effects system 
	-Surfaces can now produce different footstep sounds

notes.title: Release Date Adjustment
notes.notes:
As development has moved forward, we've recognized the potential for more in-depth gameplay and the ability to reach a broader market. 

To realize this goal, we have pushed the release date back to a more achievable date and time. However, between now and then we will be opening up a closed beta test for interested players. We are currently running a very small closed alpha test to flesh out the current game modes and to ensure the concept is well realized. 

We will be announcing the start of the Beta-Test sometime in the coming months. If you're interested in taking part, there will be a signup posted at that time. 

Thank you for your interest in our game and we look forward to having a match with you soon!
